title: Soundsystem Rot
description: A dark square sub-bass for the dub soundsystem: dry, tight, and broken, with a pitch-knock on every attack. A degradation arc is the engine - bit-crush falls from clean to brutal and downsampling climbs over a full 32-cycle pass, so the same riff slowly rots into a crunchy lo-fi grind while a tremolo gate keeps it pulsing.
code:
setcpm(75/4)
stack(
  note("<c1 c1 g0 c1 c1 eb1 g0 c1>*2").s("square")
    .penv("<-7 -5 -9 -7>/4").pattack(0.004).pdecay(0.05)
    .lpf(saw.slow(23).range(220, 720)).resonance(saw.slow(16).range(3, 11)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(saw.slow(13).range(1, 4)).lpattack(0.006).lpdecay(0.18)
    .crush(saw.slow(32).range(16, 4))
    .coarse(saw.slow(29).range(1, 6).round())
    .shape(saw.slow(19).range(0.08, 0.35))
    .tremolosync("<2 4 4 8>/4").tremolodepth(saw.slow(11).range(0.15, 0.6))
    .ply("<1 1 2 1>/2")
    .attack(0.004).decay(0.18).sustain(0.6).release(0.05)
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.42, 0.58))
    .gain(0.9)
)
